# HELIX templates for the blueprint's proposal tests

The solution-design and architecture templates of HELIX v0.18.0
(github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/helix, MIT), with the `output` part of their
`meta.yml`. The tests install them, with the starter set's templates in
`packages/create-app/test/fixtures/helix-package/`, as an app's
`.claude/skills/helix/references/`.
